CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation bound to identified content.

COD.rationale: Content (p0/current/n1 red positions), an explicit organization/presentation (the listed positions), and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition statement tied to a specific content's organization/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify referents and attributes (red/blue) with coordinate lists.

D.rationale: Origins/status fields are provided separately from coordinate content, distinguishing identity (coordinates) from status/origin.

O.rationale: The report describes how contents are presented/organized (axis orientation and explicit coordinate sets for referents), including current and candidate representations.
